About Qualys 

The Leading Provider of Information Security and Compliance Cloud Solutions 

The Qualys® Cloud Platform and integrated suite of applications helps businesses simplify security operations and lower the cost of compliance by delivering critical security intelligence on demand and automating the full spectrum of auditing, compliance and protection for IT systems and web applications. 

Qualys® Policy Compliance 

IT security, audit and compliance groups are under constant pressure to help the business comply with multiple regulations and meet the demands of internal and external auditors. In addition, many regulations contain requirements pertaining specifically to the integrity and security of the IT environment. 

Using Qualys® Policy Compliance (PC) an organization can reduce the risk of internal and external threats, while at the same time provide proof of compliance demanded by auditors across multiple compliance initiatives. Qualys® PC provides an efficient and automated workflow that allows IT security and compliance professionals to: 

Define policies that describe how an organization will provide security and integrity. 

Provide proof that the policies have been operationalized. 

Give documented evidence that the organization has discovered and fixed any policy compliance lapses. 

Qualys® PC extends the global scanning capabilities of Qualys® Vulnerability Management to collect OS Configuration and Application Access controls from hosts and other assets within the enterprise and maps this information to user-defined policies in order to accurately document compliance with security regulations and business mandates. 

Learn more about  Qualys' Policy Compliance and other solutions.
